lede: The gondola replacement project hits a critical milestone this week as the advisory committee discusses the $18M in local commitments needed by fall to secure federal funding. Meanwhile, the Historic Commission has its hands full with several projects, including staff's recommendation to deny aluminum window replacements at a historic garage on Colorado Avenue for using incompatible materials.
